news.title: Butler University to Launch Bachelor of Science in Respiratory Therapy
news.summary_en: New program will prepare future respiratory therapists to help meet Indiana’s growing healthcare workforce needs. Butler University will expand its healthcare offerings with the launch of a new Bachelor of Science in Respiratory Therapy program. The program will welcome its first cohort in fall 2027, with applications opening in January 2027.  The new degree is…
